item.title: what is Apache tomcat detault username and password?
item.description:
Summary

Tomcat is one of the most popular Java-based web servers, but its default configurations might leave it vulnerable if not properly secured. One of the most crucial aspects of securing Tomcat is configuring user roles and setting strong Apache tomcat detault username and password. In this guide, we’ll walk through five essential methods to secure your Tomcat installation by managing user access and customizing roles, using practical examples, unique code snippets, and step-by-step explanations.
